source: Server_configuration.txt derived from ark.wiki.gg Server configuration
curation: ChatGPT curated from DeepSeek extraction; no undocumented source gaps were invented.

load_policy.dynamic_config: load only for explicit dynamic/live requests
load_policy.content_niche: load only for clearly matching niche/map/content requests

safety_rules: unsupported, obsolete and unverified settings are rejected for automatic application.
AI output never writes INI directly; it must pass structured validation and preview.
